items.title: How Nubank automated disaster recovery with the AWS DevOps Agent
items.summary: Nubank serves more than 140 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia and announced in 2026 its operation in the USA, over 60% of Brazil’s adult population. Its systems run thousands of microservices on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) and process millions of transactions each day across accounts, cards, credit, investments, and insurance.
